summary: Boat capsized on the Colorado River between Burns and McCoy ~11 a.m.; a minor was separated from a family member and a full rescue operation recovered the child from the river, unresponsive despite CPR; the minor was wearing a personal flotation device; cause of death under investigation by the Eagle County Coroner.
location: Colorado River between Burns and McCoy
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Rock Creek Volunteer Fire Department; Greater Eagle Fire Protection District; Eagle River Fire Protection District; Eagle County Paramedics; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Eagle County Coroner's Office; Vail Public Safety Communications Center
notes: ECSO Media Release 06.03.23; VMRG involvement confirmed — resolves a run-550 pending 2023 water-fatality title lead.
